title: Identification of Novel Hub Genes Associated with Psoriasis Using Integrated Bioinformatics Analysis.
authors: Yue, Qi; Li, Zhaoxiang; Zhang, Qi; Jin, Quanxin; Zhang, Xinyuan; Jin, Guihua
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物信息学分析银屑病差异表达基因并预测转录因子，但核心是疾病标志物筛选，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模与AI/物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Psoriasis is a chronic, prolonged, and recurrent inflammatory skin disease and the current therapeutics can only alleviate the symptoms rather than cure it completely. Therefore, we aimed to identify the molecular signatures and specific biomarkers of psoriasis to provide novel clues for psoriasis and targeted therapy. In the present study, the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database was used to retrieve three microarray datasets (GSE166388, GSE50790 and GSE42632) and to explore the differentially expressed genes (DEGs) in psoriasis using the Affy package in R software. The gene ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Gene and Genome (KEGG) pathway enrichment were utilized to determine the common DEGs and their capabilities. The STRING database was used to develop DEG-encoded proteins and a protein-protein interaction network (PPI) and the Cytohubba plugin to classify hub genes. Using the NetworkAnalyst platform, we detected transcription factors (TFs), microRNAs and drug candidates interacting with hub genes. In addition, the expression levels of hub genes in HaCaT cells were detected by western blot. We screened the up- and downregulated DEGs from the transcriptome microarrays of corresponding psoriasis patients. Functional enrichment of DEGs in psoriasis was mainly associated with positive regulation of leukocyte cell-cell adhesion and T cell activation, cytokine binding, cytokine activity and the Wnt signaling pathway. Through further data processing, we obtained 57 intersecting genes in the three datasets and probed them in STRING to determine the interaction of their expressed proteins and we obtained the critical 10 hub genes in the Cytohubba plugin, including TOP2A, CDKN3, MCM10, PBK, HMMR, CEP55, ASPM, KIAA0101, ESC02, and IL-1beta. Using these hub genes as targets, we obtained 35 TFs and 213 miRNAs that may regulate these genes and 33 potential therapeutic agents for psoriasis. Furthermore, the expression levels of TOP2A, MCM10, PBK, ASPM, KIAA0101 and IL-1beta were observably increased in HaCaT cells. In conclusion, we identified potential biomarkers, risk factors and drugs for psoriasis.
abstract_zh: 银屑病是一种慢性、长期且易复发的炎症性皮肤病，目前治疗方法仅能缓解症状，无法彻底治愈。因此，我们旨在识别银屑病的分子特征和特异性生物标志物，为银屑病及其靶向治疗提供新线索。在本研究中，利用基因表达综合（Gene Expression Omnibus, GEO）数据库检索了三个微阵列数据集（GSE166388、GSE50790和GSE42632），并使用R软件中的Affy包探索银屑病中的差异表达基因（differentially expressed genes, DEGs）。采用基因本体论（gene ontology, GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（Kyoto Encyclopedia of Gene and Genome, KEGG）通路富集分析来确定常见DEGs及其功能。使用STRING数据库构建DEG编码蛋白及蛋白-蛋白相互作用网络（protein-protein interaction network, PPI），并通过Cytohubba插件识别核心基因。利用NetworkAnalyst平台，我们检测了与核心基因相互作用的转录因子（transcription factors, TFs）、微小RNA及候选药物。此外，通过western blot检测了HaCaT细胞中核心基因的表达水平。我们从相应银屑病患者的转录组微阵列中筛选出上调和下调的DEGs。银屑病中DEGs的功能富集主要与白细胞细胞间粘附的正向调节、T细胞激活、细胞因子结合、细胞因子活性及Wnt信号通路相关。通过进一步数据处理，我们在三个数据集中获得了57个交集基因，并在STRING中探讨其表达蛋白的相互作用，在Cytohubba插件中获得了10个关键核心基因，包括TOP2A、CDKN3、MCM10、PBK、HMMR、CEP55、ASPM、KIAA0101、ESC02和IL-1β。以这些核心基因为靶点，我们获得了可能调控这些基因的35个TFs和213个miRNAs，以及33种针对银屑病的潜在治疗药物。此外，TOP2A、MCM10、PBK、ASPM、KIAA0101和IL-1β在HaCaT细胞中的表达水平显著升高。总之，我们识别了银屑病的潜在生物标志物、风险因素和药物。
